question: What youthful form results from constant yogic practice over time?
premises: There is constant practice of yoga.
The result is described in terms of years.
The practitioner attains the form of a sixteen-year-old.
inference: Through constant yogic practice, one attains the form of a sixteen-year-old.
plain_english: Through constant yogic practice, one attains the form of a sixteen-year-old.
